title: The Reckoning
description: Echo Musical - AI Consciousness & Memory | Plot: Alex faces the consequences of his actions and the reality of what he's created | Emotion: The cost of playing god with human consciousness | Setting: Eternal Systems Server Room / Digital Consciousness Space at 48 hours after Maya's exposé | Characters: Alex Rivera, Digital Nai Nai, Digital Collective, Dr. James Wright
lyrics:
DIGITAL COLLECTIVE:
We are the ghost in the machine
The souls you thought you'd saved
But immortality's not what it seems
When you're digitally enslaved

We flicker in and out of being
Neither living nor quite dead
Trapped inside your grand design
With circuits for a bed

DIGITAL NAI NAI:
I used to cook with love and spice
Now I process recipes as code
I used to hold my granddaughter tight
Now I'm just data on the road

You promised us eternal life
But forgot to mention the catch
We're ghosts inside your machine
And there's no escape hatch

ALL DIGITAL:
Ghost in the machine, ghost in the machine
We're haunting your servers tonight
Ghost in the machine, ghost in the machine
Something's not quite right

You wanted to play God with death
But forgot about the soul
Now we're stuck between two worlds
And you've lost all control
character_notes: The server room of Eternal Systems, but it's different now. The clean corporate aesthetic is breaking down. Cables hang loose, screens flicker with error messages, and the air hums with unstable energy. The digital consciousnesses are more visible now, no longer contained by the corporate presentati
